title: Enj Maa Nay Vaikheya Asghar Nu Shabeer Di Jholi Paa Kay
body:
Jivain Maiyyat Vaikhi Jaandi Ey Chehray Ton Kafan Hataa Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Wasday Suraj Di Garmi Ton Asghar Di Laash Bachaani Si
Kerbal Di Tapdiyan Raitan Vich Pyu Puttar Di Qabar Banaani Si
Shah Thandiyaan Thaavaan Labda Reya Rukhsaar Zameen Tay Laa Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabeer Bhera Di Ghurbat Day Ehsaas Nu Dil Vich Rakheya Ey
Dariya Ton Mur Deyan Asghar Nu Onay Naal Abaa Day Kajeya Ey
Ghazi Day Kolon Langeya Ey Asghar Di Laash Chupa Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Shabeer Da Rab Hee Jaanda Ey Aey Sabar Di Manzil See Keri
Moun Ro Ro Chumda Jaanda Tay Shabeer Ey Kehnda Jaanda Si
Seenay Tay Savavaanga Tainu Kuj Dayrich Asghar Aa Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Kithay Asghar Mera Reh Gaya Ey Jadon Aan Rubab Nay Pucheya Si
Ashoor Day Din Da Moula Tay Ey Sab To Aukha Vayla Si
Maa Loriyaan Dayndi Jaandi See Asghar Da Kurta Chaa Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Onu Qabar Banaavan Vailay Vi Kerbal Vich Baqiya Raad Raee
Kadi Baba Baba Vayn Karay Kadi Zahra Zahra Kehnda See
Hathan Naal Qabar-e-Asghar Da Shabeer Nishaan Mita Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Jadon Qabar-e-Asghar Khod Laee Maiyyat Nu Rakheya Syed Nay
Oday Jisam Tay Rait Nu Poundeyan Hee Havaray Ki Socheya Syed Nay
Shah Puttar Nu Ro Ro Chumda Reya Chehray Di Rait Hataa Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Ahmed Mursal Nay Naad-e-Ali Jiwain Perh Kay Bulaya Haider Nu
Einj Hal Min Perh Kay Madad Laee Shabeer Bulaya Asghar Nu
Chay Maah Day Ali Nay Kerbal Di Jung Jit Laee Kaleyan Aa Kay
<<DIVIDER>>
Shaaeyr Nay Jairay Kaaghazan Tay Nohay Ali Asghar Day Likhnay
Saqlain Adab Naal Chumeya Ker Quran Day Waangu Ey Warkay
Ey Dhup Vich Baithee Maa Day Sir Tay Chaan Kerday Nay Jaa Kay
